LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Beginning.label: Qi Condensation Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Beginning.description: As my spiritual roots awaken throughout the entire body and begins to absorb Qi, the body experiences a qualitative improvement as every capacity becomes greater.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Foundation.label: Foundation Establishment Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Foundation.description: Qi flows through every vein and suffuses every bit of tissue, rebuilding this mortal body into an excellent foundation for further cultivation.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_CoreFormation.label: Core Formation Realm
LanguageData.label: Core-coagulation rank
LanguageData.description: Have been able to do the Qi liquefaction, and gradually master the use of core tips.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_CoreCoagulation.label: Core Transformation Realm
LanguageData.label: Core-consummation rank
LanguageData.description: Finally in the core place to cultivate a perfect golden core, and can use this to nourish the body.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_CoreImmaculacy.label: Golden Core Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Shackle.label: Soul Transformation Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Shackle.description: Nature has ensnared every living thing with layers of fetters, chaining body and soul to the tyranny of 'natural laws.' As a cultivator's progress begins to stagnate,
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_PrimordialSpiritBaby.label: Nascent Soul Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_PrimordialSpiritBaby.descripti: Safely gestated inside a Golden Core, the transformed soul gives birth to an infantile spirit made of Qi that is tethered to a cultivator's will. Although it is barely conscious, the Nascent Soul's connection to and usage of Qi is unparalleled and so, by extension, is the cultivator's.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_PrimordialSpiritMaturation.des: Strenuous effort sees a cultivator's Qi Soul mature into their twin, the mirror of a cultivator with a natural intuition for the deeper mysteries of Qi. The perfected Soul can assist a cultivator in decrypting the laws and esoterica of late-stage Qi cultivation.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_PrimordialSpiritCombine.label: Gestalt Integration Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_PrimordialSpiritCombine.descri: The cultivator fuses with their Perfected Soul and becomes a gestalt being of Qi and matter, soul and flesh. Now manipulating Qi happens at level that is almost autonomic, more natural than blinking or breathing.\nLike civilization freed man to be able to ponder philosophy, now that the minutiae of Qi usage has been handled, cultivators always find themselves looking toward the next step.
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Immortal.label: Earth Immortal Realm
LanguageData.RI_Hediff_Immortal.description: "Achieving functional immortality has only just opened my eyes. I have reached the peak and found that there is something beyond the earth I claim dominion over.\nI can still ascend to something greater. Reach out to something beyond this planet, beyond the void, and touch upon power that is truly godlike."
